comment: sptd mode only. The redis server's ConfigMap and TLS Secret are baked into its sealed launcher as descriptor files (opened as /proc/self/fd/N) (rust-envcas nonrelease-dev-baked-volumes); its redis.conf is rewritten to those descriptors and /data becomes a memory emptyDir, so redis is one bare Pod with one signed Pod plan. Values are fixed at build time; no rotation. The demo's redis.conf and the sgx/cvm modes are unchanged.
